manifest.status: conditional uncertainty diagnostics for exploratory frozen ensembles; no significance declaration or candidate switch
manifest.rng_order: one Generator; block length 5 then10, markets CEA/GUANGZHOU/SHANGHAI/HUBEI/EU
manifest.resampling: noncircular overlapping moving-origin blocks; ceil(N/L) uniformly sampled starts in [0,N-L], concatenate and truncate to N
manifest.block_units: observed unique sorted test origins, not calendar days
manifest.pairing: one sampled-origin index/count matrix per market/length shared by every model and all horizons
manifest.missing_h: missing end-of-series h rows remain missing; weighted sums divided by resampled valid count in each market/h
manifest.estimand: per-cell raw mean score then equal-weight market x h geometric ratio; no pooling sample counts across cells
manifest.market_sampling: markets never resampled or pooled; independent origin-block draws within each market, fixed five markets
metrics: MQS:2*mean15pinball per origin on stored raw Q and canonical y
manifest.intervals: 95% percentile, np.quantile(method=linear); P_boot(gain>0) is a resample fraction, not a p-value
